import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
mpl.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": False, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 10, "text.color": "#263238", "axes.labelcolor": "#263238", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
blue = "#33658A" teal = "#2A9D8F" terracotta = "#C66B4E" ink = "#263238"
A = np.array([[5.0, -3.0], [-3.0, 5.0]]) q1 = np.array([1.0, 1.0]) / np.sqrt(2.0) q2 = np.array([-1.0, 1.0]) / np.sqrt(2.0) lambda1, lambda2 = 2.0, 8.0 a1, a2 = 1.0 / np.sqrt(lambda1), 1.0 / np.sqrt(lambda2)
if not ( np.allclose(A, A.T) and np.all(np.linalg.eigvalsh(A) > 0) and np.allclose(A @ q1, lambda1 * q1) and np.allclose(A @ q2, lambda2 * q2) ): raise ValueError("The supplied matrix and eigendecomposition are inconsistent.")
theta = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 801) ellipse = ( a1 * q1[:, None] * np.cos(theta) + a2 * q2[:, None] * np.sin(theta) )
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(5.4, 4.4)) ax = fig.add_axes([0.12, 0.19, 0.76, 0.66]) ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box") ax.set_xlim(-0.81, 0.81) ax.set_ylim(-0.70, 0.70) ax.axis("off")
fig.text( 0.5, 0.955, r"$\mathbf{x}^{\top}\mathbf{A}\mathbf{x}=1$", ha="center", va="top", fontsize=15, ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.895, "A = [[5, −3], [−3, 5]]", ha="center", va="top", fontsize=10, color=ink, )
# Standard coordinate axes; coordinates are dimensionless. for endpoint, startpoint in [ ((0.77, 0), (-0.77, 0)), ((0, 0.66), (0, -0.66)), ]: ax.annotate( "", xy=endpoint, xytext=startpoint, arrowprops=dict( arrowstyle="-|>", color=ink, lw=0.9, mutation_scale=9, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, ), zorder=1, )
ax.text(0.785, -0.035, r"$x_1$", ha="left", va="top", fontsize=12) ax.text(0.035, 0.66, r"$x_2$", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=12) ax.annotate( "0", xy=(0, 0), xytext=(5, -6), textcoords="offset points", ha="left", va="top", fontsize=9, )
# Orthogonal principal-axis guides, with distinct dash patterns. for q, extent, color, linestyle in [ (q1, 0.87, teal, (0, (5, 3))), (q2, 0.64, terracotta, (0, (2, 3))), ]: points = np.outer(q, [-extent, extent]) ax.plot( points[0], points[1], color=color, lw=1.15, linestyle=linestyle, zorder=2, )
ax.plot( ellipse[0], ellipse[1], color=blue, lw=2.2, solid_capstyle="round", zorder=3, )
# Positive radial arrows end at the exact semi-axis endpoints. for q, length, color in [(q1, a1, teal), (q2, a2, terracotta)]: endpoint = length * q ax.annotate( "", xy=endpoint, xytext=(0, 0), arrowprops=dict( arrowstyle="-|>", color=color, lw=1.8, mutation_scale=12, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, ), zorder=4, )
ax.text( 0.63, 0.59, r"$\mathbf{q}_1$", color=teal, fontsize=12, ha="left", va="center", ) ax.text( -0.47, 0.46, r"$\mathbf{q}_2$", color=terracotta, fontsize=12, ha="right", va="center", )
fig.text( 0.29, 0.115, r"$\lambda_1=2,\quad a_1=1/\sqrt{2}$", ha="center", va="center", color=teal, fontsize=10, ) fig.text( 0.73, 0.115, r"$\lambda_2=8,\quad a_2=1/\sqrt{8}$", ha="center", va="center", color=terracotta, fontsize=10, ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.045, "Arrows show semi-axes; coordinates are dimensionless.", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.5, color=ink, )
